observations.description: trading_authority is checked False in report payload; all status, alert, and state records set trading_authority=False.
record_failure atomically writes UNHEALTHY status with failure_reason; unsupported reason rejects.
Failure atomically overwrites latest-watchdog-status.json; recovery overwrites failure status. Stale successful status cannot remain authoritative.
Atomic writes via .tmp-{pid} + os.replace; no temp files remaining after write.
Report stored as reports/<report_id>.json; report_id is SHA-256 content-addressed.
Alert event_id is SHA-256 over canonical JSON; alerts contain watchdog_version and trading_authority=False.
Deduplication: repeated identical signature returns False (no new alert). Recovery and regression emit new alerts. Repeated failure deduplicates.
Malformed state: wrong keys or trading_authority=True rejects. Corrupt JSON rejects.
No Start/Stop/Enable/Disable-ScheduledTask or Start/Stop-Process. No 'trading' in source.
Single-instance IgnoreNew, 4-min execution time limit, 5-min repetition, disabled after install, RunLevel Limited, no Enable-ScheduledTask, no Start-ScheduledTask.
Disclaims off-host notification and institutional/24/7 readiness. States local evidence only.
